I believe they can be defeated.''"
"''Another attack, sir? But—|Fisto and the clone commander, during the battle on Rishi|}} A '''clone trooper commander''' served in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Green Company/Legends|Green Company]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Green Company was sent to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] to [[Battle of Rishi (Clone Wars)/Legends|recapture]] [[Exonium/Legends|exonium]] [[Mining/Legends|mines]] [[Capture of Rishi|taken]] by [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] forces. Upon Green Company's arrival on Rishi, [[Rishii/Legends|Rishii]] [[Chief/Legends|Chieftain]] [[Gwarrk]] ordered the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to attack the exonium mines, but the assault was unsuccessful, and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] soon ordered a retreat. While Gwarrk pushed for another attack, Fisto asked the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] for their best [[Sniper/Legends|sharpshooter]], and the commander selected [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] [[Cooker|2242]]. After seeing Fisto weakening the enemy defenses with 2242's help, the commander rallied their [[Troop/Legends|troops]] and led them in recapturing the mines. ==Biography== {{Quote|I have looked everyplace! Where is the Jedi?!''"
"''Apparently he's begun the attack without us.|Gwarrk and the clone commander, on Fisto's plan|}} A [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone trooper commander]] was one of the many [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]].{{DB|organization|clonetroopers|clone troopers}} They were [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to fight for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] served in the Republic's [[Green Company/Legends|Green Company]]. Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]'' [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] forces [[Capture of Rishi|invaded]] the planet [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]]. They took control of the [[Exonium/Legends|exonium]] [[Mining/Legends|mines]] on the planet, since they needed to obtain exonium [[Mineral/Legends|minerals]] for their [[Sonic weapon/Legends|sonic weaponry]]. The clone commander and their [[Company/Legends|unit]] were dispatched to protect the native [[Rishii/Legends|Rishii]] and were ordered not to attack until a [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] arrived. However, Rishii [[Chief/Legends|Chieftain]] [[Gwarrk]] took command and led the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] in an [[Battle of Rishi (Clone Wars)/Legends|attack]] on the exonium mines because their people needed the minerals to prepare [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] for the [[Water/Legends|frost]] [[Time/Legends|times]]. [[File:Gwarrk_and_Fisto.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The clone commander, Kit Fisto, and Gwarrk convene after recapturing the Rishi mines.]] Due to the well-prepared defense of the Geonosians, the attack was unsuccessful, and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] ordered a retreat when he arrived on Rishi. Fisto informed the chieftain that the [[Troop/Legends|troops]] were only there for the Rishii's protection from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy]] and stated that no attack should have been made before his arrival. The clone commander informed Fisto that the Geonosians had prepared a well-entrenched defense, but Gwarrk insisted on another attack. Fisto, however, formulated another plan and asked the commander for the company's best [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]], and the commander directed him to trooper [[Cooker|2242]], nicknamed "Cooker." Soon, Fisto went to the entrance of the mines without informing the commander or Gwarrk. When Gwarrk asked the clone commander where the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] was, the commander told the Chieftain that Fisto had apparently begun an attack, as they were seeing the Jedi through their [[Electrobinoculars/Legends|electrobinoculars]]. Meanwhile, Fisto ordered Cooker to open fire, and the Jedi deflected the shots at the Geonosians with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. When the clone commander saw Fisto fighting, they rallied their troops and departed in [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]] to assist the Jedi [[General/Legends|General]]. By this time, however, the Geonosians had suffered heavy casualties as a result of Fisto and Cooker's combined efforts. The Republic forces—along with some of the Rishii warriors—then arrived and attacked the mines, forcing the remaining Geonosians stationed there to flee. Afterward, Gwarrk acknowledged that Fisto was very powerful; they also acknowledged the Jedi's fighting prowess. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Sir, the Geos are just dug in too deep.|The clone commander, briefing Kit Fisto|}} The clone commander obeyed the orders given to them by their superior [[Officer/Legends|officers]]—Chieftain Gwarrk and General Kit Fisto. However, despite being ordered not to attack until a Jedi arrived, the commander instead obeyed Gwarrk's orders to begin the battle. They remained quiet when Gwarrk insulted their troops, but after the battle, the Rishii chieftain congratulated the commander on their good work in battle. Like all clones of Jango Fett, the commander stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall and had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin. ==Equipment== As a member of the Republic's Green Company, the clone commander wore green [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]] and utilized electrobinoculars during the battle on Rishi. ==Behind the scenes== The clone commander appeared in the [[Free Comic Book Day]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] [[The Gauntlet of Death|''The Clone Wars: The Gauntlet of Death'']], written by [[Henry Gilroy]], illustrated by [[Ramón Pérez|Ramón K. Pérez]], and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] on [[May 2]], [[2009]].{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/16-214/Free-Comic-Book-Day-2009-Star-Wars-The-Clone-Wars-DH-All-Ages-Split-Issue|text=Free Comic Book Day 2009 Star Wars: The Clone Wars/DH All Ages Split Issue}} ==Appearances== *{{StoryCite|story=The Gauntlet of Death|book=Free Comic Book Day 2009 Special|sformatted=''The Gauntlet of Death''|smanual=1}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 5.11|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Comic 5.11]] ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |pl=Klon-komandor (Rishi) }} [[Category:Clone trooper commanders]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Members of Green Company]]
